name: Direct Commands
desc: Control party members in battle (also fixes the skill list in Fusion).

name: Modern Persona Switch
desc: On your turn you can switch Personas as often as you like. After a 1 More you keep that Persona until the enemy has had its turn.

name: Always Cut-In
desc: Every critical hit and every weakness strike gets its cut-in, instead of leaving it to chance.

name: Always Critical
desc: Every attack is a critical hit. This is a cheat, so it is off until you turn it on. It comes from the same GameBanana download as Always Cut-In.

name: Share Party Experience
desc: The whole party gets experience after a battle, not only the members in the fight.

name: Fast Start
desc: Skips the questions at the start about transferring data and what FES added.

name: Manual Skill Inheritance
desc: Choose which skills carry over in Fusion, instead of leaving it to chance.

name: Classroom Cheat Sheet
desc: Shows the answers to class questions and exams.

name: Social Link Cheat Sheet
desc: Shows the best answers in Social Link conversations.
